title: Parallel Computing & GPU Systems Research Fellow
description: The Egyptian Institute of High-Performance Computing (EIHPC) is seeking a Parallel Computing & GPU Systems Research Fellow for a seasonal scientific project. You will join our research group to accelerate high-performance simulations, specifically working on weather forecasting applications. Responsibilities include diagnosing performance bottlenecks, writing custom C/C++ parallel code, and implementing GPU-specific optimizations to accelerate large-scale computations. The candidate is expected to contribute to academic research papers and participate in technical reports.
requirements: Background in parallel programming, high-performance scientific computing, or GPU optimization.
Strong systems programming experience in C and C++ (Java is a plus).
Experience or academic publication history in optimizing forecasting applications, simulation engines, or GPU architectures.
Prior experience working as a Research Assistant or Teaching Assistant in an engineering department.
Master's or PhD degree in Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related technical field.
benefits: Access to high-performance GPU clusters and cutting-edge server infrastructure
Monthly stipend aligned with senior research fellow standards
Support for presenting papers at international IEEE/ACM conferences
